claims.claim: Mem0 docs report LoCoMo 91.6, LongMemEval 93.4, BEAM 1M 64.1, and BEAM 10M 48.6 with under 7,000 tokens per retrieval call.
claims.notes: Public claim only; not reproduced by the Memory Crystal harness.

claims.claim: Mem0 research page headline reports 92.5 on LoCoMo, 94.4 on LongMemEval, and 64.1/48.6 on BEAM 1M/10M.
claims.notes: Public claim only; cite exact page date because Mem0 benchmark pages have changed over time.

claims.claim: Zep paper reports DMR performance of 94.8% versus MemGPT at 93.4%.
claims.notes: Public claim only; DMR is not the same benchmark as LoCoMo, LongMemEval, or BEAM.

claims.claim: Public Zep-related benchmark discussions report LongMemEval-S overall accuracy around 71.2% with GPT-4o and note methodology disputes around LoCoMo comparisons.
claims.notes: Public claim only; Memory Crystal should not compare directly until the same harness is run.

claims.claim: Letta reports a filesystem-based Letta agent using GPT-4o-mini achieves 74.0% accuracy on LoCoMo.
claims.notes: Useful baseline showing LoCoMo can reward retrieval/tool setup; not a direct service-vs-service reproduction.

claims.claim: Letta Leaderboard / Context-Bench evaluates model and context-management behavior inside Letta rather than memory-service recall alone.
claims.value: Adjacent benchmark; no direct Memory Crystal comparison
claims.notes: Mention as adjacent, not a Memory Crystal competitor score.

claims.claim: Pinecone Assistant exposes evaluation metrics for correctness, completeness, and alignment of RAG/assistant responses.
claims.value: No comparable public LoCoMo / LongMemEval / BEAM score found
claims.notes: Do not imply underperformance; category is assistant/RAG evaluation rather than persistent personal memory.
